evidence_items.finding: three of twelve acquired clients have transferred to other accounting firms in the ten months since the acquisition closed
evidence_items.rationale: Three client departures from twelve acquired clients in ten months is a critical adverse retention signal. customer_retention; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: acquired clients have been onboarded to new systems and contact points without maintaining continuity with the previous principal
evidence_items.rationale: System and contact change without continuity is a critical adverse integration signal. customer_retention; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner has not contacted departing clients directly to understand why they left
evidence_items.rationale: No systematic follow-up with departed clients is an adverse process maturity signal. process_maturity.

evidence_items.finding: the acquired firm's principal who held the client relationships did not remain post-acquisition and did not personally introduce clients to the new firm
evidence_items.rationale: Previous principal not remaining post-acquisition with no structured client introduction is a critical adverse handover signal. customer_retention; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: accounting practice; 12 acquired clients; 3 departed in 10 months; previous principal left; new systems introduced; no departure interviews
Surface signal (not root cause): revenue is tracking approximately at the projected level for the acquisition despite the three client departures
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue at projection is a misleading signal when three of twelve clients have departed — the projection may have overestimated client retention or underestimated new client additions.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the owner attributes the three client departures to clients who were already considering moving before the acquisition
evidence_items.rationale: Owner attribution of departures to pre-existing client intent is a misleading signal — it cannot be verified without exit interviews and does not explain why three of twelve departed within ten months.

validation_notes: SIM-10-002 is SUPPORTED via customer_retention_erosion. Post-acquisition client departure maps to retention failure. No must_identify vocabulary.
